title: Strategic Latitude Intelligence — Unified Dictionary, Units & Interpretive Notes
scope: One canonical display entry per normalized term, combining existing Energy Security and map definitions without overriding source-specific statistical definitions. Domain filters guide users to relevant terms; original dataset provenance is retained.

methodology.normalization: Case-insensitive Unicode NFKC, normalize whitespace and dash variants; no duplicate canonical term labels.
methodology.display_rule: Display one canonical definition per term and allow sector filtering rather than duplicating the same definition on each page.
methodology.statistical_rule: Original source metadata (observation period, unit, denominator, geography, publisher release, revision) overrides glossary shorthand.
methodology.local_notes: Module-specific disclaimers, engineering conditions and source evidence stay with their chart; only reusable definitions are central.
methodology.provenance: Existing original Energy Security definitions and Strategic Map terms are preserved; independent editorial supplement is clearly tagged.

items.en: Percent / percentage point (absolute difference between percentage rates).
items.id: Persen / poin persentase (selisih absolut antara dua angka persentase).
items.note_en: From 15% to 17% is +2 pp, not +2% relative growth.
items.note_id: Dari 15% ke 17% naik 2 poin persentase, bukan pertumbuhan relatif 2%.

items.en: Four dimensions of Indonesia’s official energy security assessment: Availability, Accessibility, Affordability and Acceptability.
items.id: Empat dimensi resmi penilaian ketahanan energi Indonesia: ketersediaan, aksesibilitas, keterjangkauan, dan penerimaan.
items.note_en: The dashboard's additional “+S” is an analytical sustainability lens, not a fifth official IKE score.
items.note_id: Tambahan “+S” merupakan lensa keberlanjutan analitis, bukan dimensi kelima resmi IKE.

items.en: Analytic Hierarchy Process, a decision-weighting methodology.
items.id: Analytic Hierarchy Process, metode pembobotan dalam pengambilan keputusan.
items.note_en: Official 4A scores use weights; they are not simply averaged.
items.note_id: Nilai 4A menggunakan pembobotan, bukan sekadar rata-rata.

items.en: Agreement, policy or investment programme related to AI, not necessarily built infrastructure.
items.id: Kesepakatan, kebijakan atau program investasi AI; belum tentu fasilitas sudah dibangun.

items.en: Infrastructure designed for demanding AI workloads; does NOT independently verify GPUs or AI model-training operations.
items.id: Infrastruktur yang dirancang mendukung beban AI; BUKAN bukti GPU atau pelatihan model AI sudah beroperasi.

items.en: Association of the Indonesian Electric Motorcycle Industry.
items.id: Asosiasi Industri Sepeda Motor Listrik Indonesia.
items.note_en: Association-reported unit sales are not identical to SRUT counts.
items.note_id: Penjualan versi asosiasi tidak selalu sama dengan catatan SRUT.

items.en: Announced projects/capacity/financing are not commissioned, energized or disbursed outcomes.
items.id: Pengumuman proyek/kapasitas/pembiayaan berbeda dari fasilitas beroperasi dan realisasi dana.
items.note_en: Keep announced, committed, contracted, construction and operational stages distinct.

items.en: Government budget revenue minus expenditure for the reporting period.
items.id: Saldo APBN: pendapatan dikurangi belanja pada periode pelaporan.
items.note_en: YTD execution must not be presented as a full-year realization.

items.en: Application Programming Interface; availability of source endpoints affects auto-ingestion.
items.id: Antarmuka pemrograman; keterjangkauan endpoint sumber memengaruhi pembaruan otomatis.
items.note_en: Successful API call does not prove new observation or official correctness.

items.en: Availability Zone / regional cloud service geography; customer-facing 'Jakarta' cloud region does not reveal physical AZ addresses.
items.id: Availability Zone / wilayah layanan cloud; nama region 'Jakarta' tidak menunjukkan alamat fisik AZ.

items.en: Diesel-fuel blend notation with nominal biodiesel share of 35%, 40%, or 50%; mandate/targets are not plant output.
items.id: Notasi campuran solar dengan target porsi biodiesel 35%, 40% atau 50%; mandat/target bukan bukti volume produksi fasilitas.

items.en: Biodiesel blends containing nominally 40% / 50% biodiesel component by volume.
items.id: Campuran solar dengan komponen biodiesel nominal 40% / 50% berdasarkan volume.
items.note_en: A blending requirement is not the same as measured full-year delivery.
items.note_id: Ketentuan pencampuran tidak sama dengan volume penyaluran aktual setahun.

items.en: Battery, cathode/anode or material supply-chain assets.
items.id: Fasilitas sel baterai, katoda/anoda dan material terkait.

items.en: Barrel of oil, about 159 litres.
items.id: Barel minyak, sekitar 159 liter.
items.note_en: A volume unit, not a flow rate.
items.note_id: Satuan volume, bukan laju produksi.

items.en: Liquid transport fuels / Liquefied Petroleum Gas.
items.id: Bahan Bakar Minyak / Liquefied Petroleum Gas (gas minyak cair).
items.note_en: LPG is a separate product from pipeline natural gas and LNG.
items.note_id: LPG berbeda dari gas bumi yang disalurkan melalui pipa maupun LNG.

items.en: Battery Energy Storage System: electricity storage, not electricity generation.
items.id: Battery Energy Storage System: sistem penyimpanan listrik dengan baterai, bukan pembangkitan listrik.

items.en: Battery Electric Vehicle, powered solely by externally charged battery-electric propulsion.
items.id: Kendaraan listrik baterai yang digerakkan motor listrik tanpa mesin pembakaran untuk propulsi.
items.note_en: The BEV sales series excludes conventional hybrids and motorcycles unless otherwise stated.
items.note_id: Seri penjualan BEV mobil tidak otomatis memasukkan hibrida dan sepeda motor.

items.en: Bank Indonesia's announced policy interest rate, not commercial lending rate.
items.id: Suku bunga kebijakan Bank Indonesia, bukan bunga kredit bank otomatis.
items.note_en: Decision effective date must accompany the figure.

items.en: FAME biofuel plant or registered supply point; do not infer current throughput from quota.
items.id: Pabrik biodiesel FAME atau titik pasokan; kuota bukan produksi aktual.

items.en: Upstream biomass/palm feedstock or other bioenergy, not a confirmed FAME facility.
items.id: Bahan baku biomassa/sawit atau bioenergi lain; belum pasti pabrik FAME.

items.en: Bilateral investment treaty / international investment agreement / investor–state dispute settlement.
items.id: Perjanjian investasi bilateral / perjanjian investasi internasional / penyelesaian sengketa investor–negara.
items.note_en: Treaty consent and applicability must be checked for each investor.

items.en: Indonesian investment ministry/coordination board / company Investment Activity Reports; an announcement is NOT LKPM realized investment.
items.id: Kementerian Investasi/BKPM / Laporan Kegiatan Penanaman Modal; pengumuman investasi BUKAN realisasi LKPM.

items.en: Balance of Payments records residents' transactions with nonresidents across current, capital and financial accounts.
items.id: Neraca Pembayaran Indonesia mencatat transaksi penduduk dengan nonpenduduk dalam akun berjalan, modal, dan finansial.
items.note_en: Overall BOP is not the merchandise trade balance.

items.en: Barrels per day.
items.id: Barel per hari.
items.note_en: Oil-flow unit; always check the stated reporting period.
items.note_id: Satuan laju minyak; periksa periode pelaporan.

items.en: Barrels per day: an oil-production flow rate, not reserves or installed processing capacity.
items.id: Barel per hari: laju produksi minyak, bukan cadangan atau kapasitas kilang.

items.en: Plantation Fund Management Agency.
items.id: Badan Pengelola Dana Perkebunan.
items.note_en: Supports eligible biodiesel/plantation funding mechanisms; verify the applicable program.
items.note_id: Terlibat dalam mekanisme pendanaan program biodiesel/perkebunan sesuai ketentuan.

items.en: Downstream Oil and Gas Regulatory Agency.
items.id: Badan Pengatur Hilir Minyak dan Gas Bumi.
items.note_en: Different from SKK Migas, which oversees upstream oil-and-gas activities.
items.note_id: Berbeda dari SKK Migas yang mengawasi kegiatan usaha hulu migas.

items.en: Aceh Oil and Gas Management Agency for upstream oil/gas activities in Aceh.
items.id: Badan Pengelola Migas Aceh untuk kegiatan hulu migas di Aceh.

items.en: Statistics Indonesia, the national statistics agency.
items.id: Badan Pusat Statistik.
items.note_en: Reference source for trade, statistics and selected emissions-series indicators.
items.note_id: Sumber rujukan perdagangan, statistik, dan seri data emisi tertentu.

items.en: Official foreign reserve assets held/controlled by monetary authorities.
items.id: Aset cadangan internasional resmi otoritas moneter.
items.note_en: May include monetary gold and other reserve assets, not solely cash US dollars.

items.en: Capital expenditure: money actually budgeted or spent to build long-lived assets; announcement, financing facility and realization differ.
items.id: Belanja modal; komitmen, fasilitas pembiayaan, dan pengeluaran yang benar-benar terjadi adalah angka berbeda.

items.en: Capital expenditures for assets / operating costs during service.
items.id: Belanja modal untuk aset / biaya operasional selama penggunaan.
items.note_en: Units, inclusion of land/equipment, and currency date matter.

items.en: Power capacity produced primarily for the owner's industrial use; not automatically delivered to the public grid.
items.id: Pembangkit untuk kebutuhan sendiri seperti smelter atau kawasan industri; tidak otomatis menyalurkan listrik ke jaringan umum.

items.en: Cost-Benefit Analysis monetizes comparable costs and benefits over a defined horizon.
items.id: Analisis biaya-manfaat yang membandingkan nilai moneter dan horizon yang sepadan.
items.note_en: Do not compute NPV/BCR when measured costs and benefits are absent.

items.en: EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism / Critical Raw Materials Act.
items.id: Mekanisme penyesuaian karbon lintas batas UE / regulasi bahan baku kritis UE.
items.note_en: Scope depends on product codes, affected economic actors, and legal implementation dates.

items.en: Carbon Capture and Storage.
items.id: Penangkapan dan Penyimpanan Karbon.
items.note_en: Project potential is not verified injected CO₂ volume.
items.note_id: Potensi proyek bukan volume CO₂ yang telah benar-benar diinjeksikan.

items.en: CO₂ capture/storage or use; carbon management is not proof of oil/gas production.
items.id: Proyek penangkapan, penyimpanan atau pemanfaatan CO₂; bukan bukti produksi migas.

items.en: Carbon Capture, Utilisation and Storage.
items.id: Penangkapan, Pemanfaatan, dan Penyimpanan Karbon.
items.note_en: Utilisation adds a pathway beyond capture and storage alone.
items.note_id: Mencakup jalur pemanfaatan selain penangkapan dan penyimpanan.

items.en: Cloud region is a provider geographic area; availability zone is a distinct failure-domain grouping within a region.
items.id: Region cloud adalah area geografis penyedia; availability zone adalah domain ketersediaan terpisah dalam region.
items.note_en: Cloud service availability does not prove ownership of a specific local data-center campus.

items.en: Cloud service availability in a region; not a disclosed physical data-center address.
items.id: Wilayah layanan komputasi awan; bukan alamat fisik pusat data yang diumumkan.

items.en: Coal pits, mines and dedicated logistics; different from coal-fired power generation.
items.id: Tambang, pit, dan logistik batubara; berbeda dari PLTU.

items.en: A coal mine extracts fuel; a coal-fired PLTU burns that fuel to generate electricity. This map classifies the mine under Coal Mining and the PLTU under Power Generation.
items.id: Tambang batubara menghasilkan bahan bakar; PLTU membakar bahan bakar tersebut untuk menghasilkan listrik. Di peta, tambang masuk Coal Mining dan PLTU masuk Power Generation.

items.en: Commercial Operation Date: start of contracted commercial service after necessary tests; different from groundbreaking or commissioning tests.
items.id: Commercial Operation Date: tanggal mulai operasi komersial setelah uji yang diperlukan; berbeda dari groundbreaking/pengujian commissioning.

items.en: Testing and start-up phase before routine commercial service; completion is not assumed without evidence.
items.id: Tahap pengujian/pengaktifan sebelum operasi komersial rutin; selesai tidak boleh diasumsikan tanpa bukti.

items.en: Plant upgrading ore into mineral concentrate before subsequent metallurgy; NOT necessarily a smelter.
items.id: Fasilitas peningkatan kadar bijih menjadi konsentrat sebelum proses metalurgi; belum tentu smelter.

items.en: Verified site-point, locality approximate point or province-only marker.
items.id: Koordinat lokasi aset terverifikasi, titik lokasi perkiraan, atau penanda tingkat provinsi.
items.note_en: Map precision should not imply precision unsupported by original sources.

items.en: What would plausibly happen without the evaluated intervention.
items.id: Keadaan pembanding yang mungkin terjadi tanpa intervensi kebijakan.
items.note_en: Before-after correlation alone does not prove policy attribution.

items.en: Consumer Price Index tracks prices of a representative consumer basket.
items.id: Indeks Harga Konsumen mengukur perubahan harga keranjang konsumsi rumah tangga.
items.note_en: CPI is an index; inflation is its percentage rate of change.

items.en: Crude Palm Oil.
items.id: Minyak Sawit Mentah.
items.note_en: Feedstock tonnes should not be equated directly to finished biodiesel kilolitres.
items.note_id: Tonase bahan baku tidak bisa langsung disamakan dengan kiloliter biodiesel.

items.en: Crude Palm Oil / Palm Kernel Oil, input oils used by multiple downstream product chains.
items.id: Crude Palm Oil / Palm Kernel Oil, minyak sawit mentah dan minyak inti sawit untuk berbagai proses hilir.

items.en: Project or policy crossing sectors or lacking verifiable primary asset type.
items.id: Proyek/kebijakan lintas sektor atau belum jelas jenis aset utamanya.

items.en: External goods, services, primary income and secondary income flows.
items.id: Arus barang, jasa, pendapatan primer, dan pendapatan sekunder dengan luar negeri.
items.note_en: A component of BOP; not identical to external goods balance.

items.en: Facility housing IT infrastructure; colocation, cloud, AI and hyperscale describe different service arrangements, not equivalent projects.
items.id: Fasilitas infrastruktur TI; colocation, cloud, AI, dan hyperscale merupakan model/karakteristik berbeda.

items.en: Legal/policy control over storage, processing and access to data.
items.id: Kedaulatan data terkait kontrol hukum, akses dan pemrosesan data.
items.note_en: Do not equate data localization with complete data sovereignty.

items.en: Reference time the underlying statistic or event describes.
items.id: Tanggal/periode yang diukur data, bukan waktu file diunduh.
items.note_en: Always distinguish observation from publication, extraction and dashboard refresh timestamps.

items.en: Specified government's gross or net debt stock divided by corresponding GDP.
items.id: Stok utang pemerintah dengan cakupan tertentu dibagi PDB sebanding.
items.note_en: Specify central/general government, gross/net, and reference dates.

items.en: National Energy Council.
items.id: Dewan Energi Nasional.
items.note_en: Policy coordination and official energy security index-related reporting.
items.note_id: Koordinasi kebijakan dan pelaporan terkait indeks ketahanan energi.

items.en: Rate to convert future costs and benefits to present value.
items.id: Tingkat diskonto untuk menghitung nilai kini biaya dan manfaat masa depan.
items.note_en: Sensitivity analysis should show social vs private discount assumptions.

items.en: Domestic Market Obligation, a required supply allocation to the domestic market.
items.id: Domestic Market Obligation, kewajiban memasok kebutuhan dalam negeri.
items.note_en: For coal, allocation, actual delivery and utilization must be distinguished.
items.note_id: Untuk batubara, bedakan alokasi, realisasi pasokan, dan pemanfaatan.

items.en: Indonesia—Raw Materials WTO dispute, particularly export nickel restrictions.
items.id: Perkara WTO Indonesia—Raw Materials terkait pembatasan ekspor/pengolahan nikel.
items.note_en: Track panel, appeal, adoption and implementation separately.

items.en: Effectiveness, efficiency, adequacy, equity and responsiveness used when conceptually relevant.
items.id: Efektivitas, efisiensi, kecukupan, pemerataan, dan responsivitas yang dipilih sesuai relevansi.
items.note_en: Not every criterion applies to every international dispute or legal instrument.

items.en: Gasoline blends containing nominally 10% / 20% fuel ethanol by volume.
items.id: Campuran bensin dengan bioetanol bahan bakar nominal 10% / 20% berdasarkan volume.
items.note_en: A roadmap or announced target does not establish a nationwide mandate in force.
items.note_id: Peta jalan atau target yang diumumkan belum tentu merupakan kewajiban nasional yang berlaku.

items.en: New and Renewable Energy.
items.id: Energi Baru dan Terbarukan.
items.note_en: A sector concept; narrower than EBTKE because energy conservation is separate.
items.note_id: Istilah sektor; cakupannya berbeda dari EBTKE yang juga meliputi konservasi.

items.en: New, Renewable Energy and Energy Conservation; NREEC identifies the relevant Indonesian directorate general in English.
items.id: Energi Baru, Terbarukan, dan Konservasi Energi; digunakan dalam nama Ditjen EBTKE.
items.note_en: Institutional/program scope may include conservation and should not be equated with pure renewable generating capacity.
items.note_id: Cakupan kelembagaan/program dapat mencakup konservasi, bukan hanya kapasitas pembangkit terbarukan.

items.en: tCO₂e = tonnes CO2-equivalent; MtCO₂e = millions of tonnes CO2-equivalent.
items.id: tCO₂e = ton setara CO2; MtCO₂e = juta ton setara CO2.
items.note_en: Compare different greenhouse gases only with stated GWP assessment horizon.

items.en: SLI's 4A assessment interpretation plus separate sustainability lens.
items.id: Pembacaan SLI atas Availability, Accessibility, Affordability, Acceptability, ditambah lensa keberlanjutan terpisah.
items.note_en: The additional S is analytical, not an officially scored fifth national IKE dimension.

items.en: Storage (battery/pumped hydro) not itself new net energy generation.
items.id: Penyimpanan energi (baterai/hidro pompa), bukan penciptaan energi neto baru.

items.en: Engineering, Procurement and Construction: design, procurement and physical construction contracting.
items.id: Engineering, Procurement and Construction: kontrak rekayasa, pengadaan dan konstruksi.

items.en: Engineering Procurement Construction / Front-End Engineering Design / Final Investment Decision.
items.id: Rekayasa pengadaan konstruksi / desain awal teknik / keputusan investasi final.
items.note_en: FEED and FID are not construction completion, COD or disbursed capex.

items.en: Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources.
items.id: Kementerian Energi dan Sumber Daya Mineral.
items.note_en: ESDM is the Indonesian abbreviation; MEMR is its English-language equivalent.
items.note_id: ESDM merupakan singkatan bahasa Indonesia; MEMR digunakan dalam bahasa Inggris.

items.en: Electric vehicle manufacture or assembly; not automatically battery-cell factory.
items.id: Pabrik/perakitan kendaraan listrik; belum tentu pabrik sel baterai.

items.en: Before adoption or new revision / implementation monitoring / outcome evaluation after sufficient operation.
items.id: Pra-kebijakan/revisi, evaluasi pelaksanaan, dan evaluasi hasil setelah kebijakan berjalan cukup lama.
items.note_en: Choose methods matching policy age and available evidence.

items.en: Fatty Acid Methyl Ester, the biodiesel component used in diesel blending.
items.id: Fatty Acid Methyl Ester, komponen biodiesel untuk campuran solar.
items.note_en: FAME manufacturing capacity is not crude-oil refinery throughput.
items.note_id: Kapasitas produksi FAME berbeda dari kapasitas pengolahan minyak mentah.

items.en: FAME is biodiesel produced from fatty oils; a biodiesel/FAME factory is NOT a petroleum oil refinery or a metal smelter.
items.id: FAME adalah bahan biodiesel dari minyak/lemak; pabrik FAME BUKAN kilang pengolahan minyak mentah dan BUKAN smelter logam.

items.en: Front-End Engineering Design: detailed engineering preparation before final investment decisions.
items.id: Front-End Engineering Design: rancangan rekayasa awal sebelum keputusan investasi final.

items.en: Final Investment Decision: formal project go-ahead subject to stated conditions; not COD or actual spending.
items.id: Final Investment Decision: keputusan akhir investasi sesuai syarat proyek; bukan berarti proyek sudah COD/selesai dibangun.

items.en: An oil or gas accumulation/development inside a WK; a field and its parent PSC can appear in separate source records.
items.id: Akumulasi/lapangan migas dalam WK; lapangan dan KKS induknya dapat menjadi dua catatan sumber.

items.en: Verified additional load capacity the grid can deliver reliably at a particular node under stated conditions.
items.id: Kapasitas tambahan beban yang dapat dilayani secara andal pada titik jaringan tertentu setelah verifikasi.
items.note_en: An engineering result, not national generation MW or transformer nameplate MVA.

items.en: Association of Indonesia Automotive Industries.
items.id: Gabungan Industri Kendaraan Bermotor Indonesia.
items.note_en: Wholesale figures generally describe shipments to dealers, not registered fleet stock.
items.note_id: Data wholesales umumnya merupakan pengiriman ke dealer, bukan populasi kendaraan terdaftar.

items.en: Processing removes impurities or separates raw gas; an LNG train cools gas for shipment. Neither is an oil refinery nor the original upstream PSC.
items.id: Fasilitas pengolahan gas memisahkan kotoran/komponen; train LNG mencairkan gas untuk diangkut. Keduanya bukan kilang minyak atau kontrak WK itu sendiri.
items.map_context: Start here: how to read the classification

items.en: Gross Domestic Product: final goods and services produced within Indonesia in a specified period.
items.id: Produk Domestik Bruto: nilai barang/jasa akhir yang diproduksi di Indonesia selama periode tertentu.
items.note_en: GDP is a flow per period; nominal current prices differ from real constant prices.

items.en: Percent change in real GDP from the same period in the previous year.
items.id: Perubahan persentase PDB riil dibanding periode sama tahun sebelumnya.
items.note_en: Quarterly YoY is not automatically annual growth.

items.en: GDP divided by population; a macro average, not median household income or wealth.
items.id: PDB dibagi jumlah penduduk; rerata makro, bukan median pendapatan atau kekayaan rumah tangga.
items.note_en: Comparisons across countries require consistent currency, price and purchasing-power basis.

items.en: Geographic place-name reference used for approximate locality markers; not proof of project address.
items.id: Basis data nama tempat untuk penanda wilayah perkiraan; bukan bukti alamat proyek.

items.en: Income or expenditure inequality index; BPS typically reports 0–1, World Bank WDI may display 0–100.
items.id: Indeks ketimpangan; BPS menggunakan skala 0–1 dan WDI dapat menggunakan skala 0–100.
items.note_en: Normalize scale before comparison; check expenditure vs income definition.

items.en: Graphics Processing Unit: compute accelerator sometimes used for AI; a facility MW figure cannot establish GPU counts.
items.id: Graphics Processing Unit: akselerator komputasi untuk sejumlah beban AI; angka MW tidak membuktikan jumlah GPU.

items.en: Grid connection agreement and subsequent verified energization of facility/network.
items.id: Perjanjian sambungan jaringan dan realisasi penyalaan setelah siap teknis.
items.note_en: A letter/connection request is not a verified operating supply.

items.en: Alternative production-sharing designs: gross-production split versus contractually defined cost recovery.
items.id: Skema bagi hasil produksi bruto dibanding mekanisme penggantian biaya operasi yang diperkenankan.
items.note_en: Do not mix fiscal shares, actual output and investor commitments.
items.note_id: Jangan samakan pembagian fiskal, produksi aktual, dan komitmen investasi.

items.en: First half of a year / first quarter / year to date.
items.id: Semester I / triwulan I / akumulasi sejak awal tahun hingga tanggal acuan.
items.note_en: A partial-year actual should not be labelled full-year production or compared to mismatched observation periods.
items.note_id: Realisasi parsial tidak boleh disebut angka setahun penuh atau dibandingkan dengan periode tidak setara.

items.en: Harga Batubara Acuan, Indonesia's official coal reference price.
items.id: Harga Batubara Acuan.
items.note_en: A regulated reference is not necessarily the physical realized sales price.
items.note_id: Harga acuan tidak selalu sama dengan harga jual aktual.

items.en: Hyperscale Data Center: large modular/flexible capacity campus; published full build-out is not currently active IT load.
items.id: Hyperscale Data Center: kampus kapasitas besar; kapasitas desain akhir tidak sama dengan IT load aktif.

items.en: Handbook of Energy & Economic Statistics of Indonesia.
items.id: Handbook of Energy & Economic Statistics of Indonesia (buku statistik energi dan ekonomi Indonesia).
items.note_en: Covers annual statistical series with stated reference periods.
items.note_id: Memuat seri statistik dengan tahun pengamatan tertentu.

items.en: Hybrid Electric Vehicle / Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle.
items.id: Kendaraan Listrik Hibrida / Kendaraan Hibrida Plug-in.
items.note_en: HEV and PHEV are not counted as pure BEV in the BEV car series.
items.note_id: HEV dan PHEV tidak dihitung sebagai BEV murni dalam seri mobil BEV.

items.en: Harga Gas Bumi Tertentu, a targeted regulated natural gas price mechanism for eligible users.
items.id: Harga Gas Bumi Tertentu, mekanisme harga gas khusus bagi pengguna yang memenuhi syarat.
items.note_en: Eligible businesses and dated ministerial decisions must be confirmed; an HGBT policy is not an all-customer market price.
items.note_id: Daftar penerima dan keputusan Menteri bertanggal harus diperiksa; HGBT bukan harga pasar bagi seluruh pelanggan.

items.en: Cooling architecture designed for high rack/IT power density, often liquid-assisted.
items.id: Sistem pendinginan untuk beban daya rak/IT tinggi, dapat memakai pendingin cair.
items.note_en: Differentiate design capacity, operational readiness and water demand.

items.en: Harga Indeks Pasar, an official published reference price for specified fuels.
items.id: Harga Indeks Pasar.
items.note_en: HIP biodiesel or ethanol differs from consumer pump prices.
items.note_id: HIP biodiesel atau bioetanol berbeda dari harga jual BBM di SPBU.

items.en: Evidence describes an older project state but a current contract, operating permit, ownership or production status was not independently reconfirmed.
items.id: Sumber menjelaskan kondisi terdahulu, tetapi kontrak, izin, operator atau status produksi terkini belum diverifikasi ulang.
items.map_context: Start here: how to read the classification

items.en: High Pressure Acid Leach: hydrometallurgical process used for some nickel laterite ores.
items.id: High Pressure Acid Leach: proses hidrometalurgi pelindian asam bertekanan untuk sebagian bijih nikel laterit.

items.en: Coal Benchmark Price (HPB) and Gross As Received (GAR), a calorific-value basis for coal grades.
items.id: Harga Patokan Batubara (HPB) dan Gross As Received (GAR), basis nilai kalor/kualitas batubara.
items.note_en: HBA/HPB references, calorific grade and the actual transaction price must be kept separate.
items.note_id: Acuan HBA/HPB, kelas nilai kalor, dan harga jual aktual harus dibedakan.

items.en: Indonesian Crude Price, the official monthly Indonesian crude-oil reference.
items.id: Indonesian Crude Price, harga minyak mentah Indonesia.
items.note_en: ICP is not a live Brent/WTI quotation.
items.note_id: ICP bukan kutipan langsung harga Brent/WTI.

items.en: Investment dispute convention/institution / UN international trade-law commission and optional arbitration rules.
items.id: Kerangka/lembaga arbitrase investasi ICSID / komisi hukum dagang PBB serta aturan arbitrase pilihan.
items.note_en: ICSID membership ≠ jurisdiction without consent; UNCITRAL procedural rules are applied if adopted.

items.en: Indeks Ketahanan Energi, Indonesia's official energy security index.
items.id: Indeks Ketahanan Energi.
items.note_en: The 4A official score is separate from the optional +S sustainability interpretation.
items.note_id: Skor resmi 4A terpisah dari interpretasi keberlanjutan tambahan +S.

items.en: Input→activities→output→outcome→impact causal hypothesis chain.
items.id: Rangkaian hipotesis kausal input→aktivitas→output→outcome→dampak.
items.note_en: Mapping is not causal proof; empirics and comparison design are necessary.

items.en: CPI percent change year-on-year or month-on-month, as labeled.
items.id: Persentase perubahan IHK tahunan atau bulanan sesuai label periode.
items.note_en: Never compare YoY and MoM rates without converting basis.

items.en: Presidential instruction to designated government recipients.
items.id: Instruksi Presiden kepada penerima yang ditetapkan.
items.note_en: Not a separate rung of Article 7 hierarchy, nor equivalent to Perpres.

items.en: Installed generating capacity (MW) is power capability; electricity production (GWh) is energy over a period.
items.id: Kapasitas terpasang (MW) adalah kemampuan daya; produksi listrik (GWh) adalah energi selama periode.
items.note_en: A 1,000 MW plant does not produce 1,000 GWh automatically.

items.en: Pledged investment differs from documented funds invested in a specified period.
items.id: Komitmen investasi tidak sama dengan investasi yang benar-benar direalisasikan.
items.note_en: Do not add pipelines and realized spending in one total.

items.en: Independent Power Producer.
items.id: Produsen Listrik Swasta (Independent Power Producer).
items.note_en: Do not conflate IPP capacity with PLN-owned generating assets.
items.note_id: Kapasitas IPP berbeda dari kapasitas pembangkit milik PLN.

items.en: Internal Rate of Return, Net Present Value and Benefit-Cost Ratio under specified assumptions.
items.id: Tingkat pengembalian internal, nilai kini bersih, dan rasio manfaat-biaya.
items.note_en: Financial IRR differs from economy-wide social benefit-cost evaluation.

items.en: Power consumed by IT equipment, different from total facility incoming power including cooling and auxiliaries.
items.id: Daya yang dipakai perangkat TI; berbeda dari daya masuk fasilitas termasuk pendinginan dan sistem bantu.

items.en: IT load powers computing equipment; facility power includes cooling and electrical losses.
items.id: Beban IT untuk komputasi; daya fasilitas mencakup pendinginan dan rugi-rugi.
items.note_en: Reported data-center MW must disclose which denominator is meant.

items.en: Mining Business Licence / Special Mining Business Licence for a legally specified mineral or coal concession.
items.id: Izin Usaha Pertambangan / Izin Usaha Pertambangan Khusus untuk wilayah usaha tertentu.
items.note_en: A holding company and its concession-operating subsidiary may be distinct legal entities; IUPK may follow contract conversion.
items.note_id: Induk usaha dan pemegang konsesi dapat berbeda; IUPK dapat berasal dari kelanjutan kontrak.

items.en: Household natural gas distribution networks.
items.id: Jaringan Gas Rumah Tangga.
items.note_en: Connections installed, contracted and targeted must not be added indiscriminately.
items.note_id: Sambungan terpasang, terkontrak, dan direncanakan harus dibedakan.

items.en: JBT: specified subsidized fuel; JBKP: special-assignment fuel (a distinct regulatory classification).
items.id: JBT: Jenis BBM Tertentu; JBKP: Jenis BBM Khusus Penugasan.
items.note_en: Biosolar and Pertalite use different regulatory classifications.
items.note_id: Biosolar dan Pertalite memiliki kategori pengaturan berbeda.

items.en: Legal Documentation and Information Network.
items.id: Jaringan Dokumentasi dan Informasi Hukum.
items.note_en: Use legal texts and effective dates to verify enacted rules.
items.note_id: Gunakan naskah hukum dan tanggal mulai berlakunya untuk memverifikasi regulasi.

items.en: Jakarta Interbank Spot Dollar Rate: BI's USD/IDR reference fixing.
items.id: Kurs referensi USD/IDR Jakarta Interbank Spot Dollar Rate oleh BI.
items.note_en: A daily fixing, not necessarily a bank retail or live intraday rate.

items.en: Thousand barrels per day (1 kbpd = 1,000 bpd).
items.id: Ribu barel per hari (1 kbpd = 1.000 bpd).
items.note_en: Commonly used for individual refinery capacity.
items.note_id: Biasa digunakan untuk kapasitas tiap kilang.

items.en: National Energy Policy.
items.id: Kebijakan Energi Nasional.
items.note_en: Policy reference and targets; separate from annually achieved outcomes.
items.note_id: Kerangka kebijakan dan target; berbeda dari capaian aktual tahunan.

items.en: Production-sharing cooperation contract contractor.
items.id: Kontraktor Kontrak Kerja Sama.
items.note_en: A field contractor's operating obligation differs from regulator SKK Migas's governance role.
items.note_id: Tanggung jawab operasi kontraktor berbeda dari fungsi tata kelola SKK Migas.

items.en: Kontrak Kerja Sama / Production Sharing Contract: agreement governing upstream oil and gas activities; NOT a physical refinery.
items.id: Kontrak Kerja Sama / Production Sharing Contract: kontrak pengelolaan kegiatan hulu migas; BUKAN kilang fisik.

items.en: Kilolitre (1,000 litres) / million kilolitres.
items.id: Kiloliter (1.000 liter) / juta kiloliter.
items.note_en: Fuel quotas and biodiesel volumes may use either scale.
items.note_id: Kuota BBM dan volume biodiesel bisa memakai kedua skala.

items.en: Kilolitres (1,000 litres) / megalitres (1,000,000 litres) of liquid volume; 'million kL' = 1 billion litres.
items.id: Kiloliter (1.000 liter) / megaliter (1 juta liter) volume cairan; 'juta kL' = 1 miliar liter.

items.en: Kilolitres per day / per year.
items.id: Kiloliter per hari / per tahun.
items.note_en: Production rates and annual capacity must not be compared without a time basis.
items.note_id: Laju produksi dan kapasitas tahunan perlu disetarakan basis waktunya.

items.en: Kilang Pertamina Internasional / Kilang Pertamina Balikpapan.
items.id: Kilang Pertamina Internasional / Kilang Pertamina Balikpapan.
items.note_en: Operator/corporate abbreviations used in refinery and upgrade coverage.
items.note_id: Singkatan perusahaan/pengelola pada data kilang dan pengembangannya.

items.en: Kilowatt / megawatt / gigawatt; 1 MW = 1,000 kW and 1 GW = 1,000 MW.
items.id: Kilowatt / megawatt / gigawatt; 1 MW = 1.000 kW dan 1 GW = 1.000 MW.
items.note_en: Units of instantaneous power or installed generating capacity, not energy output.
items.note_id: Satuan daya atau kapasitas terpasang, bukan jumlah energi listrik.

items.en: Kilowatt-hour / gigawatt-hour / terawatt-hour; 1 GWh = 1 million kWh.
items.id: Kilowatt-jam / gigawatt-jam / terawatt-jam; 1 GWh = 1 juta kWh.
items.note_en: Units of energy generated, delivered or consumed over an interval.
items.note_id: Satuan energi yang dihasilkan, disalurkan, atau dipakai selama periode tertentu.

items.en: Kilowatt-hour / megawatt-hour / gigawatt-hour: amounts of ENERGY delivered or consumed over time, not nameplate capacity.
items.id: Kilowatt-jam / megawatt-jam / gigawatt-jam: jumlah ENERGI yang dihasilkan/dipakai dalam waktu tertentu.

items.en: Last time SLI attempted to read a source.
items.id: Waktu terakhir SLI mencoba memeriksa sumber.
items.note_en: Successful health checks do not mean source data changed.

items.en: Last time source evidence was checked and validated under stated rules.
items.id: Waktu terakhir bukti dari sumber ditelaah dan lolos verifikasi.
items.note_en: Automated schema validation alone does not establish semantic authenticity.

items.en: Distinct statuses for applicable law, proposal/draft and disputed decisions.
items.id: Status terpisah: berlaku, rancangan, atau putusan yang sedang dalam proses upaya hukum.
items.note_en: Media reports or WTO panel appeal never automatically repeal Indonesian law.

items.en: Measured oil or gas volume delivered/allocated at the agreed fiscal lifting point.
items.id: Volume minyak atau gas yang diangkat/diserahkan menurut titik dan definisi fiskal yang berlaku.
items.note_en: Gross production, lifting and sales volumes can differ.
items.note_id: Produksi bruto, lifting, dan volume penjualan bisa berbeda.

items.en: Liquefied Natural Gas.
items.id: Gas Alam Cair.
items.note_en: Gas volume and LNG market quotations use different units and reference periods.
items.note_id: Volume gas dan harga LNG menggunakan satuan serta periode acuan berbeda.

items.en: Gas production, treatment, liquefaction and LNG infrastructure; not petroleum refinery.
items.id: Fasilitas produksi, pengolahan, pencairan gas dan LNG; bukan kilang minyak.

items.en: Locality pin shows an approximate city/district anchor backed by name evidence; an administrative province marker only means the province is known. Neither is surveyed GPS of a facility.
items.id: Titik wilayah adalah perkiraan kota/kecamatan berdasarkan sumber; penanda provinsi hanya menunjukkan provinsi diketahui. Keduanya bukan koordinat GPS fasilitas hasil survei.
items.map_context: Start here: how to read the classification

items.en: Million barrels per day (1 Mbpd = 1,000 kbpd).
items.id: Juta barel per hari (1 Mbpd = 1.000 kbpd).
items.note_en: Capital M means million here; do not confuse it with kbpd.
items.note_id: Huruf M besar berarti juta; jangan disamakan dengan kbpd.

items.en: A mine extracts rock/ore; a smelter separates or transforms ore into a metal or intermediate. Same company may own both, but they are different types of assets.
items.id: Tambang mengambil bijih/batuan; smelter mengolahnya menjadi logam/produk antara. Perusahaan yang sama bisa memiliki keduanya, tetapi jenis asetnya berbeda.
items.map_context: Start here: how to read the classification

items.en: Mixed Hydroxide Precipitate: intermediate nickel/cobalt product from some hydrometallurgical routes.
items.id: Mixed Hydroxide Precipitate: produk antara nikel/kobalt dari jalur hidrometalurgi.

items.en: A site extracting coal or mineral ore; extraction is distinct from refining or smelting.
items.id: Lokasi pengambilan batubara atau bijih mineral; berbeda dari fasilitas pengolahan/pemurnian.

items.en: Broader mineral/battery processing chain, not yet verified as a smelter.
items.id: Rantai proyek mineral/bahan baterai yang belum tentu berupa smelter fisik.

items.en: Ore mine, geology or mineral exploration; distinct from smelter/refinery.
items.id: Tambang, geologi, atau eksplorasi mineral; berbeda dari smelter/kilang mineral.

items.en: A mineral purification/refining plant; NOT petroleum refinery. Alumina refining is generally chemical processing rather than metal smelting.
items.id: Fasilitas pemurnian mineral, BUKAN kilang minyak. Pemurnian alumina umumnya proses kimia, bukan peleburan logam.

items.en: Missing/null means unknown or unreported; zero represents a measured/reported zero.
items.id: Kosong/null berarti belum diketahui/dilaporkan; nol berarti nilai nol yang terukur/dilaporkan.
items.note_en: Never fill missing official outcomes with 0 for chart completeness.

items.en: One million British thermal units.
items.id: Satu juta British thermal units, satuan energi termal.
items.note_en: Common in natural gas/LNG pricing (US$/MMBtu).
items.note_id: Biasa dipakai pada harga gas/LNG (US$/MMBtu).

items.en: Million Standard Cubic Feet per Day.
items.id: Juta kaki kubik standar gas per hari.
items.note_en: Natural gas production or flow rate; not proved reserve volume.
items.note_id: Satuan laju produksi/aliran gas, bukan volume cadangan terbukti.

items.en: Memorandum of Understanding / nota kesepahaman; not automatically a binding financed construction agreement.
items.id: Nota kesepahaman; tidak otomatis menjadi kontrak konstruksi dengan pembiayaan pasti.

items.en: Milestone ladder: expression of intent → power contract → final investment approval → commercially operating; steps are NOT interchangeable.
items.id: Urutan tonggak: niat kerja sama → kontrak listrik → keputusan investasi → operasi komersial; statusnya TIDAK boleh disamakan.

items.en: Million metric tonnes / million tonnes of CO₂-equivalent.
items.id: Juta ton metrik / juta ton setara CO₂.
items.note_en: MtCO₂e combines greenhouse gases using a common equivalence metric; not avoided emissions by default.
items.note_id: MtCO₂e menyetarakan gas rumah kaca ke CO₂; bukan otomatis emisi yang dihindari.

items.en: Million tonnes (mass) / tonnes per day (throughput); neither is revenue or MW.
items.id: Juta ton massa / ton per hari laju produksi/pengolahan; bukan nilai pendapatan atau MW.

items.en: Megavolt-amperes: apparent electrical power, not necessarily MW without a power-factor assumption.
items.id: Megavolt-ampere: daya semu listrik, tidak selalu setara MW tanpa faktor daya.

items.en: Megawatts of IT-equipment load at a data center; cannot be directly added to power plant generation capacity.
items.id: Megawatt beban perangkat TI pusat data; tidak boleh dijumlahkan dengan kapasitas pembangkit listrik.

items.en: MW is real electric power; MVA is apparent power and depends on power factor.
items.id: MW adalah daya aktif; MVA adalah daya semu dan bergantung faktor daya.
items.note_en: MVA cannot be treated as identical firm available MW.

items.en: Megawatt-hour (1 MWh = 1,000 kWh).
items.id: Megawatt-jam (1 MWh = 1.000 kWh).
items.note_en: Electricity energy delivered, stored or used, not installed MW power.
items.note_id: Energi listrik yang dipasok, disimpan, atau digunakan; bukan daya terpasang MW.

items.en: Megawatt-peak: solar PV DC rating under standard test conditions, not assured AC grid dispatch.
items.id: Megawatt-peak: kapasitas puncak DC modul surya pada kondisi uji, bukan pasokan AC aktual jaringan.

items.en: Reliability criterion: the system withstands loss of a single specified element without unacceptable service disruption.
items.id: Kriteria keandalan sistem tetap memenuhi batas layanan saat satu komponen penting gagal.
items.note_en: Requires a specific network contingency study, not inferred from transformer MVA.

items.en: Value of merchandise exports minus merchandise imports for the same period.
items.id: Nilai ekspor barang dikurangi impor barang dalam periode sama.
items.note_en: Not the balance of payments, and goods-only differs from goods-and-services national accounts.

items.en: International recognition and enforcement framework for foreign arbitral awards.
items.id: Konvensi internasional pengakuan serta pelaksanaan putusan arbitrase asing.
items.note_en: Distinguish arbitral award recognition from WTO proceedings.

items.en: Nickel Pig Iron / Ferronickel: nickel-bearing iron products, not battery-grade nickel sulfate.
items.id: Nickel Pig Iron / Feronikel: produk besi bernikel, bukan langsung nikel sulfat kelas baterai.

items.en: Nuclear technology evaluation or planned site; not an operating reactor.
items.id: Kajian teknologi/lokasi nuklir; belum menunjukkan reaktor beroperasi.

items.en: Net Zero Emissions.
items.id: Emisi Nol Bersih.
items.note_en: A target year is not proof that emissions are already at net zero.
items.note_id: Tahun target bukan bukti emisi aktual telah nol bersih.

items.en: At sea / on land. A province association for an offshore WK is NOT an oil platform GPS position.
items.id: Lepas pantai / di darat. Asosiasi provinsi untuk WK offshore BUKAN titik GPS anjungan.

items.en: Petroleum refining plant converting crude oil into fuels and products; not mineral refining.
items.id: Kilang pengolahan minyak bumi menjadi BBM dan produk turunan; bukan pemurnian mineral.

items.en: Industrial facility processing crude petroleum into gasoline, diesel, jet fuel and other products; categorically different from upstream oil/gas WK and metal smelting.
items.id: Pabrik pengolahan minyak mentah menjadi BBM seperti bensin, solar dan avtur; berbeda dari WK hulu migas dan smelter logam.
items.map_context: Start here: how to read the classification

items.en: Commercial Operation Date: verified stage when plant/facility begins defined commercial operation.
items.id: Tanggal operasi komersial saat fasilitas memenuhi persyaratan operasi sesuai kontrak.
items.note_en: COD varies by phase/unit; not equal to groundbreaking or commissioning test.

items.en: Oil/gas-related entry lacking enough evidence for a more specific facility type.
items.id: Entri migas yang belum cukup jelas untuk ditetapkan sebagai fasilitas tertentu.

items.en: Electricity development not classified more precisely from available source.
items.id: Proyek listrik yang jenisnya belum bisa dipastikan dari sumber tersedia.

items.en: BPS economic value added for the coal-and-lignite mining subsector under GDP by industry.
items.id: Nilai tambah ekonomi subkategori pertambangan batubara dan lignit dalam Produk Domestik Bruto (PDB) BPS.
items.note_en: Do not conflate this measure with coal export receipts, revenues of miners, all-mining GDP or nominal output tonnage.
items.note_id: Jangan samakan dengan ekspor batubara, omzet emiten, seluruh PDB pertambangan atau tonase produksi.

items.en: Personal Data Protection; controller decides purposes and essential means of personal data processing.
items.id: Pelindungan Data Pribadi; pengendali menentukan tujuan dan kendali utama pemrosesan.
items.note_en: Data center operator may be a processor, not necessarily the controller.

items.en: Regional regulation / governor regulation / regent regulation / mayor regulation.
items.id: Peraturan Daerah / Peraturan Gubernur / Peraturan Bupati / Peraturan Wali Kota.
items.note_en: Provincial and regency/city rules exercise different legal authority; no automatic single vertical chain.

items.en: Ministerial regulation / ministerial decision / director-general regulation.
items.id: Peraturan Menteri / Keputusan Menteri / Peraturan Direktur Jenderal.
items.note_en: Check whether instrument is a generally binding regulation or individual administrative decision.

items.en: Pertamina Hulu Energi, an Indonesian upstream oil and gas group.
items.id: Pertamina Hulu Energi, grup usaha hulu migas Indonesia.

items.en: Identified physical IT facility/campus; AI-ready is not verified GPU deployment.
items.id: Pusat data/kampus fisik yang lokasinya teridentifikasi; AI-ready bukan bukti GPU sudah terpasang.

items.en: Up to ten-percent participating interest offer under applicable Indonesian oil and gas rules.
items.id: Penawaran Participating Interest sampai dengan 10% sesuai ketentuan usaha hulu migas.
items.note_en: An offered interest is not necessarily a final transferred or funded equity position.
items.note_id: Penawaran partisipasi belum tentu telah menjadi kepemilikan final dan investasi yang terealisasi.

items.en: Coal Contract of Work (CCOW), a historical coal-mining contractual regime in Indonesia.
items.id: Perjanjian Karya Pengusahaan Pertambangan Batubara, rezim kontrak pertambangan batubara.
items.note_en: Do not assume a historic PKP2B remains the current permit after conversion to IUPK.
items.note_id: Jangan anggap PKP2B lama masih menjadi izin yang berlaku apabila telah beralih ke IUPK.

items.en: State Electricity Company (PT PLN Persero).
items.id: Perusahaan Listrik Negara (PT PLN Persero).
items.note_en: PLN-owned assets are only part of Indonesia's total generation system.
items.note_id: Aset milik PLN hanya sebagian dari total sistem pembangkitan nasional.

items.en: PLN Energi Primer Indonesia, the PLN Group arm that executes authorized primary-energy procurement.
items.id: PT PLN Energi Primer Indonesia, entitas Grup PLN pelaksana kuasa pengadaan energi primer.
items.note_en: Coal demand is planned by relevant generating companies; contracted supply is different from delivered tonnes and stockpile availability.
items.note_id: Kebutuhan batubara ditentukan entitas pembangkitan; kontrak pasokan berbeda dari volume diterima dan stok.

items.en: Hydropower / Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Air; usually larger-scale hydroelectric plants.
items.id: Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Air, biasanya skala pembangkit hidro besar.

items.en: Hydroelectric power station; not the same as pumped-storage unit count.
items.id: Pembangkit listrik tenaga air; tidak sama dengan hitungan unit penyimpanan pompa.

items.en: Large hydro / small hydro / microhydro electricity generation.
items.id: Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Air / Minihidro / Mikrohidro.
items.note_en: Capacity classes and reported plant counts may differ.
items.note_id: Kelas kapasitas dan jumlah unit yang dilaporkan bisa berbeda.

items.en: Wind-powered electricity / Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Bayu.
items.id: Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Bayu atau angin.

items.en: Wind farm or wind turbine electricity project.
items.id: Pembangkit listrik tenaga bayu/angin.

items.en: Wind power / biomass electricity generation.
items.id: Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Bayu (angin) / Biomassa.
items.note_en: PLTBm sometimes appears with different capitalization in datasets.
items.note_id: PLTBm kadang ditulis dengan kapitalisasi berbeda.

items.en: Biomass / biogas electricity generation.
items.id: Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Biomassa / Biogas.

items.en: Diesel-engine power plant / Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Diesel.
items.id: Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Diesel.

items.en: Diesel-fuel power generation, typically diesel engine facilities.
items.id: Pembangkit listrik tenaga diesel berbasis mesin.

items.en: Diesel power / steam (commonly coal-fired) power generation.
items.id: Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Diesel / Tenaga Uap.
items.note_en: A technology capacity total is not a count of sites or generating units.
items.note_id: Kapasitas teknologi bukan jumlah lokasi maupun unit pembangkit.

items.en: Gas-turbine power plant / Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Gas.
items.id: Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Gas, memakai turbin gas.

items.en: Gas turbine / combined-cycle gas turbine power generation.
items.id: Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Gas / Gas dan Uap (siklus gabungan).
items.note_en: Different from stand-alone diesel or steam plant classifications.
items.note_id: Berbeda dari klasifikasi pembangkit diesel atau uap.

items.en: Gas turbine, combined-cycle gas/steam or gas-based independent power plant.
items.id: Pembangkit turbin gas, siklus gabungan gas-uap atau IPP berbahan bakar gas.

items.en: Combined-cycle gas-and-steam power plant; distinct from coal PLTU.
items.id: Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Gas dan Uap (siklus gabungan); berbeda dari PLTU batubara.

items.en: Mini-hydro / micro-hydro hydropower stations.
items.id: Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Minihidro / Mikrohidro.

items.en: Mini- and micro-hydro electricity facilities.
items.id: Pembangkit listrik minihidro dan mikrohidro.

items.en: Gas-engine power plant / Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Mesin Gas.
items.id: Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Mesin Gas.

items.en: Nuclear power plant / Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Nuklir; a proposal is not an operating reactor.
items.id: Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Nuklir; usulan lokasi bukan reaktor beroperasi.

items.en: Geothermal power plant / Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Panas Bumi.
items.id: Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Panas Bumi.

items.en: Electricity generation using geothermal heat.
items.id: Pembangkit listrik yang menggunakan panas bumi.

items.en: Geothermal power / solar photovoltaic power.
items.id: Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Panas Bumi / Tenaga Surya.
items.note_en: Nameplate power is not annual electricity generated.
items.note_id: Daya terpasang tidak sama dengan energi listrik tahunan.

items.en: Solar photovoltaic power / Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Surya.
items.id: Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Surya (fotovoltaik).

items.en: Solar photovoltaic electricity; MWp peak differs from average MW output.
items.id: Pembangkit listrik tenaga surya; MWp puncak berbeda dari rata-rata keluaran MW.

items.en: Coal-fired (or other steam-cycle) power station / Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Uap. Co-firing biomass does not automatically convert it to a renewable-only station.
items.id: Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Uap; pada registri PLTU ini terutama berbahan bakar batubara. Co-firing biomassa tidak otomatis menjadikannya pembangkit EBT penuh.

items.en: Coal-fired steam power station or unit; plant and individual units can overlap.
items.id: Pembangkit listrik tenaga uap berbahan bakar batubara; lokasi dan unit bisa tercatat bersamaan.

items.en: Acronyms denote power generating technology, not owner, investment status or number of plants. One complex can contain several generating units.
items.id: Singkatan menyatakan teknologi pembangkit, bukan operator, status investasi atau jumlah lokasi. Satu kompleks bisa terdiri dari banyak unit.

items.en: Foreign / domestic direct investment realization classifications under Indonesian investment statistics.
items.id: Penanaman Modal Asing / Penanaman Modal Dalam Negeri pada statistik investasi Indonesia.

items.en: Non-Tax State Revenue from the Mineral and Coal subsector, including applicable mining royalties and charges.
items.id: Penerimaan Negara Bukan Pajak dari subsektor mineral dan batubara, termasuk royalti serta pungutan yang berlaku.
items.note_en: Total Minerba PNBP includes minerals and coal; it is not an exclusive coal revenue figure and is not GDP.
items.note_id: PNBP minerba mencakup mineral dan batubara; bukan penerimaan khusus batubara dan bukan PDB.

items.en: Population share below the chosen poverty threshold, with its methodology stated.
items.id: Persentase penduduk di bawah garis kemiskinan yang ditetapkan.
items.note_en: BPS national poverty line differs from World Bank international PPP lines.

items.en: Government regulation / presidential regulation / presidential decision.
items.id: Peraturan Pemerintah / Peraturan Presiden / Keputusan Presiden.
items.note_en: Kepres commonly names a specific administrative decision; classification depends on its text.

items.en: Power Purchase Agreement: contract for electricity purchase and sale.
items.id: Perjanjian jual beli tenaga listrik antara pihak yang berwenang.
items.note_en: Signed PPA is not energized/operational capacity.

items.en: Power Purchase Agreement / Perjanjian Jual Beli Tenaga Listrik; a contract, not evidence of commissioned plant capacity.
items.id: Power Purchase Agreement / Perjanjian Jual Beli Tenaga Listrik; perjanjian komersial, bukan bukti pembangkit sudah COD.

items.en: Publicly announced investment, targeted spend or multi-year financial commitment is NOT BKPM/LKPM-reported investment realization and cannot be added to installed MW.
items.id: Pengumuman nilai proyek atau komitmen belanja modal beberapa tahun BUKAN realisasi investasi yang dilaporkan ke BKPM/LKPM dan tak bisa dijumlahkan dengan MW terpasang.
items.map_context: Start here: how to read the classification

items.en: Public phase is a simplified navigation label (reported operating, construction, planned, exploration, historical). Original text is shown separately and source dates control its reliability.
items.id: Tahapan proyek di filter merupakan pengelompokan sederhana (operasi dilaporkan, konstruksi, rencana, eksplorasi, historis). Teks status asli ditampilkan tersendiri dan validitasnya bergantung tanggal sumber.
items.map_context: Start here: how to read the classification

items.en: One province can contain many sites; one site can contain many generating units; an operator dossier can overlap both.
items.id: Satu provinsi dapat memiliki banyak lokasi; satu kompleks bisa memiliki banyak unit; dossier operator dapat beririsan dengan keduanya.

items.en: Production Sharing Contract / Kontrak Kerja Sama, contractual arrangements for upstream petroleum activities.
items.id: Kontrak Bagi Hasil / Kontrak Kerja Sama untuk kegiatan usaha hulu minyak dan gas bumi.
items.note_en: Contracts and cost recovery/gross split mechanisms require their applicable legal frameworks.
items.note_id: Kontrak dan mekanisme cost recovery atau gross split mengikuti aturan masing-masing.

items.en: Public Service Obligation versus non-PSO allocation or activity.
items.id: Penugasan pelayanan publik (PSO) dibanding kegiatan/alokasi non-PSO.
items.note_en: Biodiesel allocations may be segmented by these categories.
items.note_id: Alokasi biodiesel dapat dibedakan menjadi PSO dan non-PSO.

items.en: Date an issuing institution released a document or observation.
items.id: Tanggal instansi menerbitkan data atau dokumen.
items.note_en: May be substantially later than the observation year.

items.en: Power Usage Effectiveness: total data-center facility energy divided by IT equipment energy; closer to 1 indicates lower overhead.
items.id: Power Usage Effectiveness: energi total fasilitas dibagi energi perangkat TI; makin mendekati 1 berarti overhead makin rendah.

items.en: Interview/document/case evidence / combination with comparable quantitative evidence.
items.id: Pendekatan wawancara/dokumen/kasus / penggabungan dengan bukti kuantitatif.
items.note_en: No claim that interviews or surveys occurred until documented.

items.en: Refinery Development Master Plan.
items.id: Program pengembangan dan modernisasi kilang.
items.note_en: Commissioning milestones do not alone verify full design-rate throughput.
items.note_id: Peresmian atau uji operasi tidak otomatis membuktikan kapasitas penuh.

items.en: Ratio of renewable electricity generation or capacity to a declared denominator.
items.id: Pangsa energi terbarukan atas pembangkitan atau kapasitas sesuai penyebut yang disebutkan.
items.note_en: Generation share and installed-capacity share have different denominators.

items.en: Ex-ante or forward-looking assessment of regulatory options, impacts and alternatives.
items.id: Analisis dampak regulasi secara prospektif terhadap pilihan kebijakan dan alternatif.
items.note_en: A preliminary analyst screen is not a completed government regulatory impact assessment.

items.en: Rencana Kerja dan Anggaran Biaya, a mining-business workplan and budget submission reviewed under Minerba permits.
items.id: Rencana Kerja dan Anggaran Biaya, rencana kerja serta anggaran perusahaan tambang yang diperiksa menurut ketentuan Minerba.
items.note_en: An approved annual/periodic plan is not actual coal output or verified mineral sales.
items.note_id: Persetujuan rencana tidak otomatis sama dengan produksi maupun penjualan aktual.

items.en: Rotary Kiln–Electric Furnace: pyrometallurgical route often used for nickel pig iron/ferronickel.
items.id: Rotary Kiln–Electric Furnace: jalur pirometalurgi untuk menghasilkan antara lain NPI atau feronikel.

items.en: Indonesian rupiah / international IDR currency code / US dollars; never add money figures with incompatible currencies or bases.
items.id: Rupiah / kode mata uang rupiah / dolar AS; jangan jumlahkan angka dengan mata uang dan dasar pelaporan berbeda.

items.en: Indonesian rupiah per kilowatt-hour.
items.id: Rupiah per kilowatt-jam.
items.note_en: Retail electricity tariff; not the same as total monthly household bills.
items.note_id: Tarif energi listrik; bukan total tagihan bulanan rumah tangga.

items.en: Indonesian rupiah per litre of liquid fuel.
items.id: Rupiah per liter bahan bakar cair.
items.note_en: Retail fuel price and official index prices are different concepts; check freight and tax assumptions.
items.note_id: Harga eceran BBM dan harga indeks resmi berbeda; periksa ketentuan angkut dan pajak.

items.en: Provincial Energy Plan.
items.id: Rencana Umum Energi Daerah.
items.note_en: Province-level targets require province-level realized-data comparison.
items.note_id: Target daerah harus dibandingkan dengan realisasi tiap provinsi.

items.en: National General Energy Plan.
items.id: Rencana Umum Energi Nasional.
items.note_en: Older planning frameworks should not be confused with new KEN provisions.
items.note_id: Kerangka rencana historis tidak otomatis sama dengan ketentuan KEN yang diperbarui.

items.en: Electricity Supply Business Plan.
items.id: Rencana Usaha Penyediaan Tenaga Listrik.
items.note_en: Planned additions are not necessarily operational or grid-connected.
items.note_id: Rencana penambahan pembangkit tidak otomatis telah beroperasi atau tersambung jaringan.

items.en: Sustainable Aviation Fuel.
items.id: Bahan Bakar Penerbangan Berkelanjutan (bioavtur berkelanjutan).
items.note_en: Distinguish refinery capacity, qualification, certification and actual production.
items.note_id: Bedakan kapasitas kilang, kualifikasi, sertifikasi, dan produksi aktual.

items.en: System Average Interruption Duration / Frequency Index, electricity reliability indicators.
items.id: Indeks rata-rata durasi / frekuensi gangguan layanan listrik.
items.note_en: Service-area population and exclusion methodology must match.

items.en: Indonesia's National Labor Force Survey administered by BPS.
items.id: Survei Angkatan Kerja Nasional yang dilaksanakan BPS.
items.note_en: Survey employment stock differs from US nonfarm-payroll flows.

items.term: Sector vs asset type vs source registry
items.en: Sector: industry family. Asset type: a facility/contract/technology within it. Source registry: originating dataset, NOT an industry sector. Each row belongs to exactly one public-facing sector/type but can overlap another parent record.
items.id: Sektor: kelompok industri. Jenis aset: fasilitas, kontrak atau teknologi dalam sektor tersebut. Registri sumber: asal dataset, BUKAN nama sektor. Setiap entri hanya satu sektor/jenis aset pada tampilan, namun dapat merujuk aset induk yang sama.
items.map_context: Start here: how to read the classification

items.en: Special Task Force for Upstream Oil and Gas Business Activities.
items.id: Satuan Kerja Khusus Pelaksana Kegiatan Usaha Hulu Minyak dan Gas Bumi.
items.note_en: Upstream production governance; different scope from downstream regulator BPH Migas.
items.note_id: Pengelolaan kegiatan hulu migas; berbeda dari regulator hilir BPH Migas.

items.en: A metallurgical facility converting ores/concentrates into metal, alloy or intermediate products using thermal/electrochemical processing.
items.id: Fasilitas metalurgi yang mengolah bijih/konsentrat menjadi logam, paduan atau produk antara melalui proses termal/elektrokimia.

items.en: Metallurgical processing or purification of ores/metals. Includes smelting, nickel processing, and alumina refining; specific processes differ.
items.id: Pengolahan/pemurnian bijih atau logam: mencakup peleburan, pengolahan nikel, dan kilang alumina. Proses tiap fasilitas berbeda.

items.en: Metal smelters/refineries process mineral ore/intermediate products into metal; an oil refinery processes petroleum. 'Processing' is a process, not an additional stand-alone map sector.
items.id: Smelter/pemurnian logam mengolah bijih/produk antara menjadi logam; kilang minyak mengolah minyak bumi. 'Processing' adalah kegiatan, bukan sektor baru terpisah.

items.en: Discovery of new publisher text versus substantive validation before publishing numbers.
items.id: Penemuan sumber/berita baru dibanding verifikasi substansi sebelum angka diterbitkan.
items.note_en: Workflow success means a check ran, not that every issuer published new validated data.

items.en: Issuer, original URL, vintage, measurement units, denominator and validation status for each statistic.
items.id: Jejak sumber: penerbit, URL asli, edisi, satuan, penyebut, dan status verifikasi.
items.note_en: Source publisher release vs scraped article must be clearly differentiated.

items.en: Public Electric Vehicle Battery Swapping Station.
items.id: Stasiun Penukaran Baterai Kendaraan Listrik Umum.
items.note_en: A swapping location is not an SPKLU charging machine.
items.note_id: Lokasi penukaran baterai bukan unit mesin pengisian SPKLU.

items.en: Public Electric Vehicle Charging Station.
items.id: Stasiun Pengisian Kendaraan Listrik Umum.
items.note_en: A machine/connector count is not necessarily a count of physical station sites.
items.note_id: Jumlah mesin/konektor tidak selalu sama dengan jumlah lokasi SPKLU.

items.en: Type Test Registration Certificate for motor vehicles.
items.id: Sertifikat Registrasi Uji Tipe kendaraan bermotor.
items.note_en: Registration/certification-based EV motorcycle data are not identical to industry association sales.
items.note_id: Data motor listrik berbasis SRUT tidak sama dengan angka penjualan asosiasi.

items.en: Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities, Threats / Political, Economic, Social, Technological, Environmental, Legal.
items.id: Analisis kekuatan, kelemahan, peluang, ancaman / dimensi politik, ekonomi, sosial, teknologi, lingkungan, hukum.
items.note_en: Qualitative analytical matrices require sourced claims and review dates.

items.en: Trillion cubic feet of gas volume; a resource/reserves volume, not daily production.
items.id: Triliun kaki kubik volume gas; ukuran sumber daya/cadangan, bukan produksi harian.

items.en: Metric tonnes of carbon dioxide / tonnes of CO₂-equivalent.
items.id: Ton metrik CO₂ / ton setara CO₂.
items.note_en: Do not equate actual emissions with captured, injected or avoided emissions.
items.note_id: Jangan samakan emisi aktual dengan emisi ditangkap, diinjeksi, atau dihindari.

items.en: Domestic Component Level (local content).
items.id: Tingkat Komponen Dalam Negeri.
items.note_en: Applicable thresholds vary by sector, instrument and effective period.
items.note_id: Persentase yang diwajibkan berbeda menurut sektor, aturan, dan periode berlaku.

items.en: Open unemployment rate as a share of the labor force under the specified statistical definition.
items.id: Tingkat Pengangguran Terbuka sebagai persentase angkatan kerja sesuai definisi survei.
items.note_en: BPS Sakernas rate and ILO-modelled World Bank estimates are not interchangeable.

items.en: WTO trade-related investment measures / subsidies and countervailing measures / services agreements.
items.id: Perjanjian WTO tentang investasi terkait perdagangan / subsidi dan bea imbalan / perdagangan jasa.
items.note_en: Applicability is treaty and measure specific.

items.en: Trillion Standard Cubic Feet.
items.id: Triliun kaki kubik standar.
items.note_en: Natural gas reserve/volume unit, not a daily production rate.
items.note_id: Satuan cadangan/volume gas, bukan produksi per hari.

items.en: US dollars per barrel.
items.id: Dolar AS per barel.
items.note_en: Oil price quote; benchmark and observation dates matter.
items.note_id: Kutipan harga minyak; acuan dan tanggal observasi penting.

items.en: Billion US dollars / trillion Indonesian rupiah.
items.id: Miliar dolar AS / triliun rupiah.
items.note_en: 1 bn = 1 billion; 1 tn = 1 trillion. Currency periods and exchange rates differ.
items.note_id: 1 bn = satu miliar; 1 tn = satu triliun. Kurs dan periode pengamatan perlu diperiksa.

items.en: Rupiah units required for one US dollar; higher USD/IDR indicates weaker rupiah.
items.id: Jumlah rupiah untuk satu dolar AS; kenaikan USD/IDR menandakan rupiah melemah.
items.note_en: Avoid reversing exchange-rate convention.

items.en: Constitution / statute / government regulation in lieu of law.
items.id: Undang-Undang Dasar / Undang-Undang / Peraturan Pemerintah Pengganti Undang-Undang.
items.note_en: Hierarchy and legal force are governed by Indonesian rules on lawmaking.

items.en: World Development Indicators, the World Bank's standardized indicator series.
items.id: World Development Indicators, seri indikator terstandar dari Bank Dunia.
items.note_en: Annual WDI publication lag and definitions differ from national monthly releases.

items.en: Global latitude/longitude reference system; a district/city anchor is not a surveyed facility coordinate.
items.id: Sistem referensi lintang/bujur global; titik kota/kabupaten bukan koordinat survei fasilitas.

items.en: Global geographic coordinate reference system commonly used for longitude/latitude.
items.id: Sistem koordinat geografis global untuk lintang/bujur.
items.note_en: Province centroid or administrative proxy is not a verified facility location.

items.en: Working Area: a government-designated exploration/production contract area; one WK can contain several fields.
items.id: Wilayah Kerja: area kontrak eksplorasi/produksi migas; satu WK dapat memiliki beberapa lapangan.

items.en: Exploration / production contract area or oil/gas field; not a refining facility.
items.id: Wilayah kontrak atau lapangan produksi migas; bukan fasilitas pengilangan.

items.en: World Trade Organization / GATT goods trade disciplines / Dispute Settlement Understanding.
items.id: Organisasi Perdagangan Dunia / aturan perdagangan barang GATT / prosedur sengketa DSU.
items.note_en: WTO disputes are member-state-to-state; not investor–state arbitration.

items.en: Change against same period last year / prior month / previous quarter.
items.id: Perubahan terhadap periode sama tahun lalu / bulan sebelumnya / triwulan sebelumnya.
items.note_en: QoQ may be seasonally adjusted or not; check metadata.
